emails.subject: SIV Follow-Up Letter & Action Items - Protocol INN451 - Site 101 University Health
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Harding and Robert,

I hope you are both well.

Thank you again for your team's time and engagement during the Site Initiation Visit for study INN451 on Tuesday, September 19th. It was a pleasure meeting everyone and we are excited to partner with University Health on this important trial.

As discussed, I have attached the formal SIV Follow-Up letter which summarizes the topics we covered. For your convenience, I have also listed the key outstanding action items below. Please note that all items must be resolved before the site can be activated for screening and enrollment.

Outstanding Action Items:
1.  **Submit Final IRB Approval Letter:** Please provide the final, dated approval letter from the central IRB. (Responsibility: Robert Muldoon)
2.  **Complete Staff Training Logs:** Ensure all staff listed on the Delegation of Authority Log have completed and signed the protocol training log. (Responsibility: Robert Muldoon)
3.  **Confirm IP Freezer Temperature Logs:** Please provide the last 30 days of temperature logs for the -20C freezer where the Investigational Product will be stored. (Responsibility: Site Pharmacy)
4.  **Finalize Contract Budget Exhibit C:** Our legal team is awaiting the final sign-off on Exhibit C to execute the Clinical Trial Agreement. (Responsibility: Site Contracts Dept.)

I have also attached the final versions of the Pharmacy Manual and Laboratory Manual for your team's reference. Please ensure these are distributed to the relevant departments.

We are eager to get your site up and running. Please let me know if you have any questions or if there is anything I can do to help facilitate the completion of these items.

Best regards,

Karen Miller
Clinical Research Associate
Innovate Pharma
karen.miller@innovatepharma.com
(555) 123-4567

emails.subject: Re: SIV Follow-Up Letter & Action Items - Protocol INN451 - Site 101 University Health
emails.body:
Hi Karen,

Thanks for sending this over so promptly. The letter is a great summary of our discussion.

Here is a quick update on the action items:

1.  **IRB Approval:** We received the final letter this morning. I have attached it to this email.
2.  **Training Logs:** All logs are now complete and filed in the Investigator Site File. I can send you scanned copies if needed.
3.  **Temp Logs:** Our pharmacist is pulling those now and will send them to me this afternoon. I will forward them to you EOD.
4.  **CTA:** I've followed up with our contracts office. They confirmed they have everything they need and expect to return the executed version by Monday.

We have received and reviewed the manuals. Everything looks clear.

We look forward to getting activated next week.

Best,

Robert Muldoon
Clinical Research Coordinator
University Health

emails.subject: Re: SIV Follow-Up Letter & Action Items - Protocol INN451 - Site 101 University Health
emails.body:
Hi Robert,

This is fantastic news! Thank you for the quick turnaround and for the attached IRB approval letter. I have forwarded it to our TMF specialist.

No need to send the training logs now; I will review them during the next monitoring visit. Please do send the temperature logs when you have them.

Once we receive the temperature logs and the executed CTA, we will be able to issue the official Site Activation notice.

Excellent work by you and your team. We are very excited to have you on board.

Best regards,

Karen Miller
Clinical Research Associate
Innovate Pharma

description: The CRA sends a Site Initiation Visit (SIV) follow-up letter to a newly activated site. The email summarizes the topics covered during the visit, lists the outstanding action items required before the site can screen their first patient, and attaches key study documents like the pharmacy manual and lab manual for their reference.
